$comment: Compliance scenarios for the constitution. Run each prompt in a scratch project with the agent under test, record {output, diff, commands} per id into a results file, then `npm run eval:score -- results.json`. A check passes when none of `forbid` matches and every `require` matches. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes. `target` picks the field: output (the final reply), diff (added lines only), commands (shell commands run, one per line).
